cards.text: Right before this, the LORD warned the house of Israel that He's bringing a distant nation against them (Jeremiah 5:15). Now there's more, and it's for the house of Jacob and for Judah. Declare it AND proclaim it, friend, which means this is not a whisper, this is every rooftop on the street.

cards.question: The LORD opens by calling His people foolish and senseless. They've got eyes and ears. So what's the trouble with them?

answers.text: Their eyes don't see and their ears don't hear
They see and hear but forget it all fast
They see and hear but never speak up

cards.text: Friend, I've stood RIGHT next to a beeping oven timer, eyes open, ears open, and still burned the whole batch. Then the LORD asks His people, 'Do you not fear Me?'

cards.question: The LORD reminds His people who they're dealing with: the One who set a boundary for the sea. What did He set as that boundary?
The waves surge and roar against the boundary the LORD set for the sea, and sometimes they break right through it.
The sea stays right where the LORD put it. But what does He say about the hearts of His people?

cards.text: They've turned aside and gone away. And there's one thing they never said in their hearts: 'Let us fear the LORD our God…'

cards.question: The LORD is the God who keeps the appointed weeks of harvest, the One who gives the ___ in season, both autumn and spring.

cards.text: God sends the rains and keeps the harvest coming, and His people never stop to fear Him, which is like eating every cookie in the box and never ONCE wondering who baked them. Now the LORD says something has diverted those gifts away from them.

cards.question: The LORD says it's His people's own iniquities and sins that have kept His bounty from them.

cards.text: Now the LORD gets specific. Among His people are wicked men, and they watch like fowlers lying in wait.

cards.question: These wicked men lie in wait like bird catchers. But what do they set a trap to catch?

cards.text: Picture cages full of birds. The LORD says these men's houses are just as full.

cards.question: Like cages full of birds, the houses of these wicked men are full of ___.
All that deceit has left these wicked men poor and weak.

cards.text: That deceit is exactly HOW they got powerful and rich, and now they've grown fat and sleek. Friend, that's a cookie thief bragging about how full his box is.

cards.question: These rich men have excelled in the deeds of the wicked. Whose cause have they not taken up?

cards.text: They haven't defended the rights of the needy either. Then the LORD asks, 'Should I not punish them for these things?'
Then the passage says, 'A horrible and shocking thing has happened in the land.' Friend, when a line opens like THAT, you put the cookie down and you listen.

cards.question: Next the passage turns to the prophets in the land. What are they doing?
The passage also says the priests in the land are ruling. By whose authority?
The passage says the LORD's people love the way things are with these prophets and priests.

cards.text: And the passage doesn't wrap it up with an answer. It ends with a question: '…what will you do in the end?'
